## What the metrics imply (quick read)
- **tuning_mean/min**: how the model performs on the tuning suite; lower is better (assuming these are loss/error-like scores). `min` reflects best-case across runs/tasks; `mean` is overall.
- **lockbox_mean/min**: same idea, but on the holdout/lockbox suite. This is your “don’t overfit” guardrail.

## Recommended execution order (and why)

python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_autopilot.py --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml --run --select-best

- Any candidates that improve **lockbox_mean** vs 1.7925 (or meet your configured threshold).

2) **Run system-level autopilot**
```bash
python3 experiment_system/tools/system_autopilot.py --spec experiment_system/config/system_candidates.yaml --run

```
